name: MIKROMB
recent: Mikro MSC 以 RM30 million 全股票方式收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 100% 股权，51,724,138 股代价股已于 2026 年 11 月 19 日上市，交易完成。同期公司出现多项主要职员变动，执行董事 Yim Yuen Wah 在闭市期增持股份。
notable: 完成以 RM30 million 全股票收购 Broadguard Sdn Bhd 100% 股权，发行 51,724,138 股新股。
执行董事 Yim Yuen Wah 在闭市期以每股 RM0.675 增持 22,200,000 股。
公司出现多项主要职员变动，涉及 Badlishah bin Ab Hapidz、Tay Siang Hui 及 Chan Yaw Sang。
risks: 收购以发行新股支付，现有股东持股可能被摊薄。
执行董事在闭市期进行股份交易，需留意后续股权变动披露。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM20.35 million，环比增长 15.9%，同比增长 3.9%；净利为 RM4.91 million，环比增长 23.3%，同比增长 58.0%，净利率为 24.1%。

recent_en: Mikro MSC completed its RM30 million all-share acquisition of Broadguard Sdn Bhd, with 51,724,138 consideration shares listed on 19 November 2026. The company also saw several principal officer changes, and Executive Director Yim Yuen Wah acquired shares during the closed period.
notable_en: Completed the RM30 million all-share acquisition of 100% of Broadguard Sdn Bhd via issuance of 51,724,138 new shares.
Executive Director Yim Yuen Wah acquired 22,200,000 shares at RM0.675 per share during the closed period.
Several principal officer changes involving Badlishah bin Ab Hapidz, Tay Siang Hui and Chan Yaw Sang.
risks_en: The acquisition was satisfied via new share issuance, which may dilute existing shareholders.
An executive director traded shares during the closed period; further shareholding disclosures should be monitored.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM20.35 million, up 15.9% QoQ and 3.9% YoY; net income was RM4.91 million, up 23.3% QoQ and 58.0% YoY, with a net margin of 24.1%.
